description_en: Logs on to a simple application server on Workbench
description_zh: 使用Workbench远程登录轻量应用服务器
name: LoginInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The username of the simple application server.

For a Linux server, you do not need to enter a username.

For a Windows server, the default username `administrator` is used
parameters.help_zh:
轻量应用服务器用户名。

Linux服务器不需要输入用户名。
Windows服务器默认用户名为`administrator`
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The password that corresponds to the username.

For a Linux server, you do not need to enter a password.

For a Windows server, enter the password that you set. If you have not set a password for the simple application server, set a password. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60055.html
parameters.help_zh:
轻量应用服务器用户名对应的密码。

Linux服务器：不需要输入密码。
Windows服务器：输入已设置的密码。如果您购买轻量应用服务器后没有设置密码，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60055.html
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The port number that is used to log on to the simple application server by using Workbench.

Linux servers: The default value is 22.

Windows servers: The default value is 3389.

If you want to connect to a server by using a custom port, you must modify the default remote connection port. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807402.html
parameters.help_zh:
远程登录实例的端口号。

Linux服务器：默认为22。

Windows服务器：默认为3389。

如果您需要使用自定义端口连接服务器，需要先修改服务器默认远程端口。具体操作，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807402.html
parameters.name: port

RedirectUrl.description_en: The URL that you use to log on to the server
